সমান্তর ও গুনোত্তর ধারা, পাটিগণিত এবং জ্.question: ২০) The 9th term of an AP is 449 and 449th term is 9.The term which is equal to zero?
সমান্তর ও গুনোত্তর ধারা, পাটিগণিত এবং জ্.exp:
an = a+(n−1)d
a9 = 449 = a+(9−1)d = a+8d ..... (1)
a449 = 9 = a+(449−1)d = a+448d ..... (2)

Subtracting
440d = −440
⇒ d = −440/440 = −1
and a+8d = 449
Or, a+8×(−1) = 449
⇒ a = 449+8 = 457
∴ 0 = a+(n−1)d
⇒ 0 = 457+(n−1)(−1)
⇒ 0 = 457−n+1
⇒ n = 458
∴ 458th term = 0
